How to travel cheap

Skyscanner (no tax/bank upfront)

https://www.skyscanner.com?pid=ozarkprepper

Google Flights (no tax/bank upfront)

https://www.google.com/travel/flights?pid=ozarkprepper

  • Fly mid-week. Tuesday and Wednesday are often cheaper than Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
  • Fly at dawn or late night. These seats are often cheaper.
  • Set a price alert. Many sites let you do this free.
  • Fly light. A small backpack fits under the seat. Many airlines charge for bags.
  • Stay off tourist season. Shoulder season is cheaper and less crowded.
  • Use free tools. Google Flights, Expedia, and airline sites let you compare prices free. Do not pay a travel agent to do this.

Cheap travel is a skill, not luck. The people who travel cheap do not have more money; they have a plan. Plan your dates, fly light, and set alerts before you search. Then book with the links on this page if you want to.
